analysis_type: Conservative log-domain support for native Chwirut1 exponential-rational predictions using denominator secants and a finite set of tangents, full three-parameter ellipsoid support, exponentiation and intersection with stage-44 independent envelopes; no global optimizer, probability or independent-replication claim

log_support_rule.model: f(x,theta)=exp(-b1*x)/(b2+b3*x), with x>0 and denominator positivity already certified over the frozen ellipsoid and each held-out distance interval
log_support_rule.log_identity: log(f)=-b1*x-log(d), where d=b2+b3*x>0. The transform does not replace or approximate the native model
log_support_rule.denominator_interval: At each unique held-out distance, use the frozen denominator minimum and maximum from the stage-44 envelope and require both to be strictly positive
log_support_rule.upper_log_bound: Because log(d) is concave, its secant on [d_min,d_max] is a lower bound. Hence -log(d) is bounded above by minus the secant. Combine -b1*x with the negative secant to form a linear function of b1,b2,b3 and compute its exact ellipsoid upper support
log_support_rule.lower_log_bound: Every tangent of log(d) at d0>0 is an upper bound. Hence -log(d) is bounded below by minus that tangent. Combine -b1*x with the negative tangent to form a linear function and compute its exact ellipsoid lower support
log_support_rule.tangent_selection: Compute all three tangent lower supports without post-hoc additions and take their maximum as a valid lower bound; the finite set is not a global optimizer
log_support_rule.prediction_conversion: Exponentiate the lower and upper log supports with outward rounding, then intersect with the stage-44 independent envelope by taking the maximum lower bound and minimum upper bound
log_support_rule.nonempty_gate: Require every intersection to be nonempty and every frozen center prediction to remain inside the log alternative and intersection
log_support_rule.scope: The log alternative uses exact linear support for each secant or tangent but is not the joint nonlinear global optimum over the ellipsoid

candidate_rule.direction_formula: For each parameter p in {b1,b2,b3} and each sign, use theta_candidate=theta_center+sign*radius*(C*e_p)/sqrt(C_pp); all parameters may move through the covariance direction
candidate_rule.feasibility: Require every candidate to have full ellipsoid quadratic form 16 within the high-precision tolerance and strictly positive denominator at every evaluated distance
candidate_rule.evaluation: Evaluate the original exp(-b1*x)/(b2+b3*x) at every unique held-out distance and every candidate, using high-precision arithmetic and cross-checking the frozen native model
candidate_rule.containment: Require all candidates to remain inside the stage-44 independent envelope, the log alternative and the intersection; record any violation instead of hiding it
candidate_rule.scope: Candidates are implementation-consistency witnesses, not global optimizers or the analytic proof

comparison_rule.alternative_comparison: Compare log-alternative widths with stage-44 independent widths and preserve tighter, wider and equal outcomes
comparison_rule.intersection_comparison: Report intersection width ratio and reduction for every unique distance; unchanged cases remain valid and are not hidden
comparison_rule.point_accounting: Keep all 214 held-out observations for residual and center consistency but construct only 22 unique-distance envelopes, avoiding duplicate-envelope counts
comparison_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite the stage-44 baseline, receipts, protocols, reports, figures or Word documents

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic, exact secant/tangent formulas, full ellipsoid support and the frozen native model
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter outward conversion to certified log and prediction bounds
numerical_rule.certificate_class: High-precision numerical conservative interval, not exact rational algebra or a probability region
numerical_rule.positive_denominator_gate: Reject non-positive denominator minima rather than taking a logarithm or constructing a finite bound
numerical_rule.native_crosscheck: Cross-check high-precision center and candidate predictions against the frozen native_model implementation

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Chwirut1对数支撑交集_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, covariance matrices, folds, denominator intervals or post-hoc tangent directions
No logarithm of a non-positive denominator or finite bound when positivity is not certified
No coordinate-only candidate directions that ignore off-diagonal covariance
No calling the finite tangent set, log alternative or intersection a global nonlinear optimum
No assumption that the alternative or intersection is tighter everywhere
No hiding of wider alternatives, unchanged intersections or candidate violations
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage, independent-model-family or independent-experiment claim
No exact rational-certificate claim or replacement of historical baselines
